fashion.Overview: Galaxy print was most famously applied to leggings, which were often paired with oversized sweaters or graphic tees. Other popular items included skater skirts, mass-produced hoodies (often featuring images of wolves), sweatshirts, dresses, and footwear, particularly Vans and the chunky Jeffrey Campbell "Lita" boots. The aesthetic often existed alongside other defining motifs of the 2010s Tumblr era. It was frequently paired with accessories like mustache necklaces and clothing featuring other trendy patterns like "Aztec" print. The overall look was eclectic and expressive, often incorporating elements of fantasy with unicorns and aliens, as well as a bright, sometimes neon, color palette.…
